model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accumulation correlation (ACC) values for five different algorithms as a function of co-occurrence number. The x-axis, labeled "Co-occurrence Number," is linear and ranges from 1.0 to 10^10, with tick labels spaced by values of 10, starting at 1.0 and ending at 10.0. The y-axis, labeled “ACC (%),” is linear and ranges from approximately 40 to 65, with tick labels spaced in increments of 5. Five lines are plotted: a black line representing the “Base” algorithm, which begins at a value of approximately 40 and increases to approximately 63; a purple line representing the “MEND” algorithm, which begins at a value of approximately 45 and increases to approximately 65; a cyan line represents the “FT” algorithm, which begins at a value of approximately 52 and increases to approximately 63; a red line represents the “IKE” algorithm, which begins at approximately 43 and increases to approximately 58; and a green line represents the “ROME” algorithm, which begins at approximately 52 and increases to approximately 62.
